items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: John Mezzi is in a band out in Mitchell Field... He said, 'Why don’t you call John Mezzi?' And I did... That got me at Mitchell Field.

ctx.x: What did the war years bring for you personally?

Disaster. No. Here again I have to thank Red Norvo for so many things. We were standing in a bar, the Forest Bar used to be a hangout for musicians in New York. I was still with Claude Thornhill. But Red and I were standing at the bar on like maybe a Monday night or something, and I was about to be drafted, and he said — John Mezzi, who had played saxophone with him, he played with Harry James and Raymond Scott and everything, but he played with Red Norvo — John Mezzi is in a band out in Mitchell Field, Long…
So you spent the military years playing.
